hints.title: Bottom-Up Uniformity Verification
hints.text: A node roots a uniform tree if both child subtrees are uniform and match the node value.

hints.title: Postorder Subtree Status Accumulation
hints.text: Evaluate left and right children first. Increment global count if both subtrees are valid and child values equal root value.

hints.title: Recursive Uniform Subtree Count
hints.text: Define helper(node) returning boolean. If node is null, return true. Evaluate is_left = helper(node.left) and is_right = helper(node.right). If both are true and any existing child has matching value, increment count and return true. Else return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal bottom-up postorder traversal verifying univalue condition once per node.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Top-down checking from each node repeats child node inspections in quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Postorder returns boolean status upward in O(H) call stack memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Both child recursions must execute to count all valid subtrees even if one child is non-uniform.
